arStrings.szText:
You gain stacking bonuses the longer you stay {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c}:
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds - {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"|%x|]{/c} Damage and {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"|%|]{/c} Fury Cost Reduction.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"]{/c} seconds - {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 4"]{/c} Fury Per Second and {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 5"|%|]{/c} Cooldown Reduction.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 6"]{/c} seconds - Every {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 7"]{/c} seconds, trigger a random {c_important}Shout{/c} Skill.
{icon:bullet, 1.2} {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 8"]{/c} seconds - {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 9"|%x|]{/c} increased damage against Elites.
